title: getPanelPluginMetas must still run unconditionally (public dashboards)
answers: Why does getPanelPluginMetas run even when not logged in?
Can I guard getPanelPluginMetas behind orgRole like the extension registries?
Public dashboard panels missing/fallback to config.panels
body:
Symptom: if getPanelPluginMetas() is skipped for anonymous users, getPanelPluginsMetasMapSync throws, currently masked by a silent fallback to config.panels.
Root cause: public/app/app.ts GrafanaApp.init still awaits getPanelPluginMetas() unconditionally (unlike the plugin-extension registries call, which IS guarded by `contextSrv.user.orgRole !== ''`), because public dashboards/snapshots need panel metas without a logged-in user.
Fix pattern: do not copy the orgRole login-guard pattern onto this call; it's intentionally unconditional until getPanelPluginsMetasMapSync usages are migrated to the async getPanelPluginsMetasMap (tracked via TODOs in app.ts).
Constraints: only remove/guard this call after removing all usages of getPanelPluginsMetasMapSync; until then, anonymous/public rendering paths rely on it running.
applies: public/app/app.ts GrafanaApp initialization, panel plugin metas loading
